name: OS-HELP
summary: A loan for flights, rent and other costs when you study overseas as part of your Australian degree.
key: Up to $8,442 for six months, or $10,130 in Asia. Plus up to $1,354 for approved Asian language study.
who: Students in a Commonwealth supported place who are Australian citizens or eligible non-citizens.
You've finished one full-time year of your course and will have at least one unit left when you return.
Your uni has selected you, and your overseas subjects count toward your degree.
how: Talk to your uni's international or exchange office about its selection process.
Confirm the overseas subjects will be credited.
Once selected, submit the OS-HELP eCAF your uni gives you.
catches: It doesn't cover a whole course taken overseas.
You can't get it if you've already had OS-HELP more than once.
